recall.minute: The race car (v* = (15.5, 14.5); q*(C,F) = 15.5, q*(C,S) = 14.95, q*(W,S) = 14.5, q*(W,F) = −10) is learned without its model from the episode C,F,+2,W,S,+1,C,F,+2,W,F,−10,O. Monte Carlo with γ = 0.6 computes returns backwards (G₃ = −10, G₂ = −4, G₁ = −1.4, G₀ = 1.16); first-visit sets Q(C,F) = 1.16, Q(W,S) = −1.4, Q(W,F) = −10, while every-visit averages (C,F) to −1.42. Off-policy MC weights returns by Π π/b (1/0.4 = 2.5; zero once b deviates from a deterministic π), with ordinary (unbiased, high variance) and weighted (biased, low variance) estimators. TD(0) with γ = 0.9, α = 0.5 gives V(C) = 1, V(W) = 0.95 during the episode. SARSA (α = 0.8) gives 1.6, 1.952 and −8; Expected SARSA and Q-learning also start at 1.6; Q-learning gives 17.15 after a +20 reward. Double Q selects with one table and evaluates with the other (5.2). Over many episodes Q-learning approaches q*, while on-policy methods estimate the ε-greedy policy (~11). DP needs a model; MC waits and has high variance; TD bootstraps every step.
